output.population: Twenty-nine young adults [16 female (21.3+/-0.54; mean yrs+/-SE), 13 male (22.85+/- 0.42)]; five adults were excluded for excessive movement
output.summary: Pilot fMRI dataset of young adults exposed via an automated olfactometer to lavender scent and synthetic male and female pheromones in a three-block design, examining sex differences in brain activation.
